evidence: Rowan card: rowan-api v1 is accountless — identity is a client-minted UUID sent as X-Device-Id; see rowan-site/site-audit-contract.json.
Quietoak and Alder are likewise accountless; see quietoak-site/privacy.html and alder-site/site-audit-contract.json.
Rowan: docs/PLAN.md §6 forbids ad and analytics SDKs touching health data; none are present.
Waddleton: js/economy.js adAvailable() and watchAd() return false unconditionally, and no ad SDK ships in the client.
Per-product evidence is recorded in each site's own site-audit-contract.json.
Quietoak card claim 'crisis kit ... always free and works offline' matches the shipped Quietoak product copy at quietoak-site/index.html and its privacy page.

hypersage-site is static HTML: a grep of every page for gtag, googletagmanager, google-analytics, PostHog, Plausible, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, Hotjar, Clarity, Meta pixel, Matomo, Fathom, and Sentry returns no match.
No document.cookie, localStorage, or sessionStorage use anywhere in the site.
The only third-party hosts the pages contact are fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (Google Fonts) plus GitHub Pages hosting — both are disclosed by name in privacy.html.
